theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_bml_rpm_dilation_map
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < lam → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → Measure.map (dilation a lam) (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ 2) • μ) K < ∞) ∧ (∀ S : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet S → Measure.map (dilation a lam) (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ 2) • μ) S = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ 2) * μ (dilation a lam ⁻¹' S)) ∧ ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → ∫ x, g x ∂(Measure.map (dilation a lam) (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ 2) • μ)) = lam⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ x, g (dilation a lam x) ∂μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
